settings.title: Real shiatsu kneading, not vibration
settings.text: Eight rotating nodes press and roll deep into the muscle — the same motion a massage therapist uses on stubborn knots.

settings.title: 26W brushless motor with real grip
settings.text: Strong enough to work through tight trapezius muscle, quiet enough to use on the sofa while everyone else watches TV.

settings.title: Hands-free cross-strap design
settings.text: Slip your arms through the straps to control the pressure. Lean in for deeper work, ease off to unwind.

settings.title: 15 minutes is all it takes
settings.text: Use it after work, before bed, or between meetings. Built-in heat helps muscles let go faster.

settings.title: Your nightly wind-down

settings.title: Between back-to-back calls
settings.text: The wearable cross-strap design means you can keep typing while the nodes work through your trapezius.

settings.title: Cloud White or Stone Grey

settings.question: Is it actually strong enough?
settings.answer: Yes — and this is the most common worry. The 26W brushless motor drives eight kneading nodes with enough torque to work through dense shoulder muscle. Start on the lower setting; most people never need the highest one.

settings.question: How fast is shipping?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1 business day from our U.S. warehouse and arrive in 2–5 business days. You'll get a tracking link the moment it leaves.

settings.question: How does it work?
settings.answer: Slip it around your neck like a scarf and put your arms through the straps. Eight heated nodes rotate in a shiatsu kneading pattern — pull down gently on the straps to increase pressure, or relax them to ease off. One button, three intensity levels.

settings.question: What if it's not for me?
settings.answer: Use it for up to 30 nights. If it doesn't earn its place in your evening routine, send it back for a full refund — we cover return shipping in the U.S.

settings.question: Can I use it on other muscles?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Customers use it on the lower back, calves, and thighs. The strap design works anywhere you can hold it against the muscle.
